structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a copycat pump.fun "e/acc / Effective Accelerationism" token. It copies the description and the Beff Jezos/UsePaid framing of the canonical e/acc coin (CbcyNo..., about $17M market cap, about 6h older), and its website link in the packet even points to the canonical token's UsePaid page. It spiked to an ATH of about $0.000914 (roughly $914k market cap) within minutes of its 04:04 UTC pool creation. It then crashed about 85-87% in the last 5 minutes to about $114k. The roughly 2.7k unique buyers and sellers look like mistaken or overflow buyers from the canonical coin's hype, followed by a dump.

narrative.description: e/acc (effective accelerationism, Beff Jezos / Guillaume Verdon) memecoin that routes creator fees to @beffjezos via UsePaid/X Money. The canonical token has run to about $17M.
narrative.why_spreading: Beff Jezos is a well-known figure on X. The UsePaid fee-to-X-account mechanic is new and has been covered in the news (KuCoin, ChainCatcher). All of that attention goes to the canonical CA, though.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name and ticker, copied description. The website link points to the canonical token CbcyNo on UsePaid, so this is not the token people mean.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo7m1amFWqEQm2m4PLv1UNvpcL3C1Ujm6AkzpKoU is canonical at $17M market cap with $745k liquidity. There is an old 2024 e/acc (Gqm...) and another fresh copy (vBiBov...).

authenticity.evidence: Many unique buyers (2.7k), probably confused traders chasing the canonical coin. The 900k-to-114k collapse suggests early holders dumped. GMGN shows few bundlers or snipers and low top-10 concentration.
